product.name: Subscription Cancellation Service
product.description: A service that automates the cancellation of various subscriptions and free trials to prevent unwanted charges.

product.name: Consumer Rights Self-Help Platform
product.description: A platform providing information and tools to help consumers address disputes, appeals, and complaints against corporations and bureaucracies.

product.name: Hidden Money Finder
product.description: A tool that helps users locate unclaimed money, rebates, and lost funds they may be entitled to recover.

product.name: AI-Powered Legal Document Generation
product.description: An AI-driven service that creates legal documents such as appeal letters, complaints, and requests to support consumer rights and bureaucratic processes.

product.name: Burner Phones and Burner Cards
product.description: Services providing temporary phone numbers and payment cards to protect user privacy and prevent spam or unwanted charges.
